Maya (SecOps): Heads up: abnormal reuse of admin session cookies detected against /admin/api in prod-east. Looks like automated replay from a handful of IPs. No confirmed data access but risk of privilege escalation.

Evan (SRE): Confirmed ~800 requests in 8m, 2 reused admin sessions from staging creds. I've blacklisted 6 IPs at the edge.

Priya (Platform): Immediate mitigations?

Maya (SecOps): Quick actions (0-1h):
- Rotate gateway cookie signing key (all envs).
- Shorten admin session TTL to 1h and expire existing sessions.
- Apply strict rate limit on /admin/*: 6 req/min per IP.
- Block offending CIDRs in WAF.

Evan (SRE): Applying rate limits and WAF blocks now. Kicking off secret rotation.

ci-bot: deployment api-gateway v3.15.0 restart initiated by Evan  8 pods restarting.

Maya (SecOps): After rotation run: curl -I -H 'Cookie: session=<old>' https://admin.redwood-inference.internal/status should return 401. Paste results here.

Evan (SRE): Old cookie rejected, 401. WAF blocked 6 IPs. Rotation complete.

Maya (SecOps): Thanks. Follow-ups (24-72h): audit services accepting long-lived cookies, update SDK guidance, create monitoring alert for admin-session-reuse >3 in 5m -> pager. I'll open a postmortem doc.

Priya (Platform): I'll add the alert and own the TTL rollouts.

Maya (SecOps): Marking this P1 until all owners confirm remediation. :lock:
